newsitem.title: CANADA: Placer says Teck, Newmont at Busang talks.
newsitem.headline: Placer says Teck, Newmont at Busang talks.

text.p: Placer Dome Inc, Newmont Mining Corp, Teck Corp and Barrick Gold Corp have all been talking with Bre-X Minerals Ltd for months to participate in the huge Busang gold deposit in Indonesia, Placer Dome chief executive John Willson told Reuters on Tuesday.

Teck's chief financial officer, John Taylor, confirmed his company has negotiated with Bre-X in the past and would be interested in negotiating again if the Indonesian government opens the door to a bidding process.
But Teck would probably not make a bid alone, Taylor said.
